title: Photoelectrochemical water splitting using TiO2/α-Fe2O3 heterojunction films produced by chemical vapour deposition
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31931-31945
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05064B, Paper

Abdullah M. Alotaibi, Hussam M. Alzahrani, Saud M. Alosaimi, Abdullah M. Alqahtani, Mohammed A. Alhajji, Mohammed J. Alotaibi
This study reports enhanced PEC performance of TiO2/α-Fe2O3 heterostructure films made via sequential AACVD of hematite (450 °C) followed by APCVD of anatase TiO2 with controlled thickness.
